stemMd: Choose the version that clearly shows that the camera, rather than the photographer, is mounted on a tripod.

options.label: A
options.textMd: The photographer, mounted on a tripod, used a camera to record the birds.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Mounted on a tripod, the camera recorded the nesting birds.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Mounted on a tripod, the birds were recorded by the photographer.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Mounted on a tripod, the photographer recorded the birds with a camera.

explanationMd: Place the object described by the opening phrase immediately after it. Making the camera the main subject clearly identifies what was mounted on the tripod.

distractorRationale.a: This explicitly makes the photographer the mounted object.
distractorRationale.c: The modifier incorrectly attaches to the birds.
distractorRationale.d: The modifier grammatically attaches to the photographer.
